execution_rules.frozen_reference_rule: Under no circumstances may Figure 2a reference coordinates, tau_c, or specification_matrix.json be modified during or after execution.
execution_rules.defect_handling_rule: If an execution error occurs (e.g. unexpected schema formatting), the issue must be documented as an execution finding; any code patch requires a new commit and a new run ID (e.g. run-002-a1h). run-001-a1h remains immutable.
execution_rules.outcome_reporting: Full 12-model specification matrix (M01-M12), element-wise residuals, condition pass rates, and global consistency flag must be reported verbatim.
